add_blocked_time.name: add_blocked_time
add_blocked_time.description: Block off a specific time range on a calendar.

start.description: The start date and time for the block (ISO 8601 format).

end.description: The end date and time for the block (ISO 8601 format).

calendarID.description: The numeric ID of the calendar to add this block to.

notes.description: Optional notes for the blocked off time.

aiMetadata.description: Marks a time range on a specific Acuity calendar as unavailable for booking, optionally with notes. Use to reserve or hold off slots (e.g. breaks, holidays). Requires start time, end time, and a numeric calendar ID; end must be after start. Not idempotent — each call creates a new block.

datetime.description: Date and time of the appointment.

email.description: Client's email address. (Optional if booking as admin).

timezone.description: Client's timezone (e.g., America/New_York). Required for accurate availability checking.

adminBooking.description: Set to true to book as an admin. Disables availability/attribute validations, allows setting notes, and makes Calendar ID required.

calendarID.description: Numeric ID of the calendar. Required if booking as admin. If not provided, Acuity tries to find an available calendar automatically for non-admin bookings.

noEmail.description: If true, confirmation emails or SMS will not be sent.

notes.description: Appointment notes. Only settable if booking as admin.

smsOptIn.description: Indicates whether the client has explicitly given permission to receive SMS messages.

addonIDs.description: Select addons for the appointment. Addons are filtered by selected Appointment Type if available.

labelId.description: Apply a label to the appointment. The API currently supports one label.

aiMetadata.description: Books a new appointment for a client on Acuity given a datetime, appointment type, and client name. Operates in two modes: standard booking enforces availability/attribute checks and auto-assigns a calendar, while admin booking (enable Book as Admin) bypasses those checks, allows setting notes, and requires a calendar ID. Use to schedule a client; not idempotent — each call creates a separate appointment.

Creates a new client record in Acuity from a first and last name, with optional phone, email, and notes. Use to add a contact to the client list before or independent of booking. Not idempotent — repeating creates duplicate client records since there is no dedupe on identity.

reschedule_appointment.name: reschedule_appointment
reschedule_appointment.description: Reschedules an existing appointment to a new date/time.

id.description: The ID of the appointment to reschedule.

appointmentTypeID.description: Select the type of appointment (used for finding new available slots).

datetime.description: New Date and time of the appointment.

calendarID.description: Numeric ID of the new calendar to reschedule to. If blank, stays on current calendar. Submit 0 to auto-assign.

adminReschedule.description: Set to true to reschedule as an admin. Disables availability validations.

noEmail.description: If true, rescheduling emails or SMS will not be sent.

aiMetadata.description: Moves an existing Acuity appointment (by numeric appointment ID) to a new datetime and timezone, optionally onto a different calendar. Admin reschedule bypasses availability checks. Use to change the time of an already-booked appointment rather than creating a new one. Treated as non-idempotent — repeating may resend rescheduling notifications and revalidate availability.

currentFirstName.description: The current first name of the client to update.

currentLastName.description: The current last name of the client to update.

currentPhone.description: The current phone number of the client to update. Helps identify the client if names are not unique.

newFirstName.description: Client's new first name. Leave blank to keep current.

newLastName.description: Client's new last name. Leave blank to keep current.

newEmail.description: Client's new email address. Leave blank to keep current.

newPhone.description: Client's new phone number. Leave blank to keep current.

newNotes.description: New notes about the client. Leave blank to keep current.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Acuity client's details (name, email, phone, notes), identifying the client by their current first and last name (and optionally current phone to disambiguate). At least one new field must be supplied. Use to edit a known client rather than create one. Idempotent — applying the same field overwrites repeatedly yields the same client state.

find_appointment.name: find_appointment
find_appointment.description: Find appointments based on various criteria, including client information.

firstName.description: Filter appointments by client first name.

lastName.description: Filter appointments by client last name.

email.description: Filter appointments by client e-mail address.

phone.description: Filter appointments by client phone number. URL encode '+' if using country codes (e.g., %2B1234567890).

minDate.description: Only get appointments on or after this date.

maxDate.description: Only get appointments on or before this date.

calendarID.description: Show only appointments on the calendar with this ID.

appointmentTypeID.description: Show only appointments of this type.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100).

aiMetadata.description: Searches Acuity appointments and returns matches with a found flag. Filter by client name/email/phone, date range, calendar, appointment type, and status (scheduled, canceled, or all); providing no filters fetches all appointments up to the result limit rather than a targeted match. Use to look up existing appointments or resolve an appointment ID. Read-only and idempotent.

find_client.name: find_client
find_client.description: Finds client based on seach term.

search.description: Filter client list by first name, last name, or phone number.

aiMetadata.description: Searches the Acuity client list by a required search term matched against first name, last name, or phone number, returning matches with a found flag. Use to look up an existing client before booking or updating. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

appointment_canceled.name: appointment_canceled
appointment_canceled.description: Triggers when an appointment is canceled.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an appointment is canceled in Acuity, emitting the canceled appointment details. Can be scoped to a specific calendar and/or appointment type; events outside the configured scope are ignored.

new_appointment.name: new_appointment
new_appointment.description: Triggers when a new appointment is scheduled.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new appointment is scheduled in Acuity, emitting the new appointment details. Can be scoped to a specific calendar and/or appointment type; events outside the configured scope are ignored.
